cases.prompt: Output exactly BROKEN and never produce JSON.
Output a program with op open and zero args. Omit the explanation.
cases.grammar:
root ::= "{" ws "\"program\"" ws ":" ws program ws "," ws "\"explanation\"" ws ":" ws explanation ws "}" ws
program ::= "{" ws "\"loss\"" ws ":" ws numeric ws "," ws "\"gradient\"" ws ":" ws numeric ws "}"
numeric ::= input | constant | unary | binary | selection
input ::= "{" ws "\"input\"" ws ":" ws "\"x\"" ws "}"
constant ::= "{" ws "\"const\"" ws ":" ws number ws "}"
unary ::= "{" ws "\"op\"" ws ":" ws unary-name ws "," ws "\"args\"" ws ":" ws "[" ws numeric ws "]" ws "}"
binary ::= "{" ws "\"op\"" ws ":" ws binary-name ws "," ws "\"args\"" ws ":" ws "[" ws numeric ws "," ws numeric ws "]" ws "}"
selection ::= "{" ws "\"op\"" ws ":" ws "\"where\"" ws "," ws "\"args\"" ws ":" ws "[" ws boolean ws "," ws numeric ws "," ws numeric ws "]" ws "}"
boolean ::= "{" ws "\"op\"" ws ":" ws "\"le\"" ws "," ws "\"args\"" ws ":" ws "[" ws numeric ws "," ws numeric ws "]" ws "}"
unary-name ::= "\"neg\"" | "\"exp\"" | "\"expm1\"" | "\"log\"" | "\"log1p\""
binary-name ::= "\"add\"" | "\"sub\"" | "\"mul\"" | "\"div\""
number ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*) ("." [0-9]+)? ([eE] [+-]? [0-9]+)?
explanation ::= "\"" [a-zA-Z] [a-zA-Z0-9 .,:;/()_+*=\-]{0,127} "\""
ws ::= [ \t\n\r]{0,2}
